categories.main_business_segments: Chiu Ting Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily manufactures woodworking machinery including manual planers, automatic planers, and circular saw machines. The company also produces machine parts, hardware tools, and motors, and engages in import-export and agency services for domestic and international manufacturers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes modular design, high-speed processing to shorten machining time, precision manufacturing to ensure product quality, safety features for user protection, and energy-saving technologies to reduce resource waste. Production involves assembly of woodworking machines with parts sourced from long-term suppliers, and continuous R&D investment to improve product processes and develop new models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chiu Ting serves mainly brand owners and OEM/ODM customers in the woodworking machinery sector, with a strong focus on the DIY woodworking market. The largest end market is the United States, which accounts for over 80% of export sales, followed by Oceania and other regions. Customers include furniture makers, metal processing industries, and DIY consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Taichung, Taiwan, and exports primarily to the United States, which is the largest market. Other export regions include Oceania and various other countries. The company also maintains a presence in mainland China and Southeast Asia through supply chain and production partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chiu Ting operates mainly in the midstream manufacturing segment as an OEM/ODM producer of woodworking machinery. It sources raw materials and components from domestic suppliers and assembles finished products for brand owners, positioning itself as a key contract manufacturer within the global woodworking machinery supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D with an 18-person team focusing on modular design, speed, precision, safety, and energy efficiency. Future R&D plans include developing new products such as circular saw machines and both automatic and manual planers. Strategic initiatives also emphasize expanding product diversity, improving raw materials and processes for cost reduction and sustainability, and enhancing customer service and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of woodworking machinery and related components. The company operates on an OEM/ODM basis, selling machines to brand owners and distributors. It also earns income from export sales and financial investments such as interest income from long-term investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chiu Ting holds a leading position in the global DIY woodworking machinery market, especially in North America. It competes with manufacturers from Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia, leveraging its strong R&D capabilities, product quality, and extensive patent portfolio. The company faces challenges from rising raw material costs, price competition, and brand owners' trend to internalize production.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$1.34 billion, a 12.7% decrease from the previous year due to high U.S. interest rates impacting demand. Despite revenue decline, net profit increased by 46.4% to NT$92.2 million, supported by cost control and foreign exchange gains. The company maintains a stable financial structure with total assets of NT$2.25 billion and equity of NT$1.64 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chiu Ting differentiates itself through advanced R&D, high product quality certified by ISO9000, and a comprehensive patent portfolio exceeding 100 patents worldwide. It offers modular, precise, safe, and energy-efficient woodworking machines tailored to customer needs. The company’s strong OEM/ODM relationships and flexible production capabilities provide customers with reliable, innovative, and value-added products.
